column3: yac candraprabhavaṃ varāmbaragataṃ yal liṅgasaṃjñaṃ jalaṃ sa prāṇas tadadhaḥ sthiraṃ ca kamalaṃ dhatte mukhordhvaṃ hṛdi ||
baddhvā kumbhakam ātmagāḍharacitaṃ tad brahmanāḍīgataṃ hy ānetuṃ vadane ṣaḍadhvagakalā saivaṃvidhā sāraṇā ||
ghaṇṭākoṭikapolakoṭarakuṭījihvāgramadhyāśrayācchaṅkhinyāgatarājadantavivaraṃ prāntordhvavaktreṇa yat ||
samprāptaṃ hanurandhramūlavidhinā yac candratoyaṃ mukhe tat sarvaṃ ravikālarūpasadane rakṣet parā sāraṇā ||
nṛtyan nityordhvajihvo yadi pibati pumān vaktradhārāmṛtaughaṃ susvādaṃ śītalāṅgaṃ duritabhayaharaṃ kṣutpipāsāvināśi ||
piṇḍasthairyaṃ yad asmād bhavati bata mahāmṛtyurogā dravante daurbhāgyaṃ yāti nāśaṃ harati viṣajarāṃ yāti kāle bhramitvā ||
jihvāgraṃ tv atha rājadantavivaraṃ nītvā tato ghaṇṭikāṃ saṃsthāpya pratijihvaparva śaśino mārge kalāṃ ca kṣipet ||
evaṃsāraṇike patanti ca sudhādhārāḥ punaḥ ṣaṇmukhagāndhārāpy atha tatkalāpamathanaṃ nāḍīmukhojjṛmbhaṇam ||
prāṇavātena nītvordhvaṃ koṭare candrajāṃ kalām ||
manthitāṃ divyajātāṃ ca tena gāndhārakarmaṇā ||
nāsāpaścimamārgavāhapavanāt prāṇe .tidīrghīkṛte candrāmbu pratisāraṇāṃ sukṛtinaḥ prāgghaṇṭikāyāḥ pathaḥ ||
siñcan kālaviśālavahnivaśagaṃ bhūtvā sa nāḍīśataṃ tat kāryaṃ kurute punar navatanuṃ jīrṇadrumaskandhavat ||
protkṣiptaṃ vṛṣaṇasya golakayugaṃ madhye dhvajaṃ proddhvajaṃ nityordhve bata śaṅkhasāraṇavidhau vaktraṃ vidheyaṃ nijam ||
sarvasthānaśarīrabandhanavaśāt skandhoddhṛtānāṃ yathā nāḍīnāṃ mukhataḥ sudhānidhijalaṃ siñcann adho gacchati ||
vṛṣaṇākarṣaṇaṃ kāryam athavā śaṅkhasāraṇā ||
bodhanaṃ caiva kuṇḍalyās tiṣṭhec caivotkaṭāsanam ||
paścād āsanaśuddhavātanikarān ādāya kaṇṭhavraṇāt saṃsthāpyā ravimaṇḍale tu bhujagī sambhūtanāḍītrayāt ||
devī madhyapathoditā prakurute kampaṃ tato mūrchanāṃ dūrakarṣaṇadarśanaṃ śrutigaṇāṃś cānyā mahāsāraṇā ||
ādhārāmbujakośakandabhujagī sambhūya nāḍītrayāt candrārkodbhavanāḍikordhvayugalaṃ cādvaitapathyāgatam ||
tatraivāṅgulibhir nipīḍya kramaśaḥ śāntiṃ mano mārutaṃ candro yāti raviṃ tataś ca bhuvane tulyā mahāsāraṇā ||
sūryāntaḥ śaśivīcidantavadanaprāntaplavaughoragī samprāpte pavanātisaṅgaharaṇe kṣipraṃ tato dhāvitā ||
śrīmanmadhyapathāntato vidadhatī kampādi kopānvitā tasyaivāśrayayāyino .pi śaśino dattā sudhā saṃmatā ||
ādau śoṣaṇiko .tra sāraṇam ataḥ kāryaṃ mahāsāraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ pratisāraṇaṃ ca guruṇā nirdiṣṭamārgaṃ kramāt ||
paścād eva ca śaṅkhasāraṇavidhau kāryaṃ mahāsāraṇaṃ sammūrchā vitatākṛtiḥ pratidinaṃ velātrayaṃ dīyatām ||
ākuñcyāgajakāmarūpam acalaṃ bandhatvajātaṃ tanau nātyūrdhve caturaṅgulāgravidite sthāne hṛdā prāṇite ||
dantair bandhurite ca vātayugale praśleṣaṇāśleṣaṇāt nābhigranthivimokṣapātasahaje mārge manaḥsiddhayaḥ ||
dūrākāravisarpite ca pavane nābheś ca mārgasthite bandheṣu triṣu satsu so .pi śithile madhyaprabodhe sati ||
kṣipraṃ ca dhriyate dvipīṭhamaruto .py ūrdhvakramākarṣaṇe saṃyukto gaticittaśoṣaṇam ataḥ prāpye .nile tiṣṭhati ||
mūle mūlordhvacakre vṛṣaṇakulatale vahnimātaṅgakūle kampakṣobhabhramāḍhye dhvanitaparicayaṃ gharmapātordhvaroma ||
bhūmityāgaṃ kavitvaṃ parapuraviśanaṃ vaśyam ākarṣaṇaṃ ca hy evaṃ vā cetanāptā prabhavati nikhilā khecaratvapratiṣṭhā ||
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca tat |

column3: hṛdaye parame dhāmni madhye tu ravicandramāḥ ||
nādaṃ tu taṃ gṛhītvā ca caitanyaṃ tatra yojayet |

column3: śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati |
anyat sarvaṃ parityajya śabdabrahma sadābhyaset ||
svasaṃvedyam asaṃvedyaṃ śabdabrahma dvidhā sthitam |
cinoti prathamaḥ śabdaś ciñcinoti dvitīyakaḥ ||
vivaraś ca tṛtīyaḥ syāc chaṅkhaśabdaś caturthakaḥ |
pañcamo meghanirghoṣaḥ ṣaṣṭham etad udīraṇam ||
saptamaṃ kāṃsyatālākhyaṃ meghaśabdas tathāṣṭamam |
navamo .py agnidāhaś ca daśamo dundubhisvanaḥ ||
anāhataninādo .yaṃ pavanāntavinirgataḥ |
dhvanitena vinā yas tu nādaś caivam apaṇḍitaḥ ||
cinoti rasam uddhṛtya ciñcinoti bhagāśritam |
virasāṃśena samprāptaṃ meghaśabdena cāviśet ||
majjāṃ patati nirghoṣaḥ saṃsthitodadhibhīṣaṇaḥ |
kāṃsyatāle nabhaḥśabdaḥ prāṇameghadhvaniḥ kramāt ||
jīvaś caivāgnidāhaḥ syān mokṣaḥ samaraso bhavet |
viśuddham ittham ātmānaṃ paśyeta cātmanātmani ||
prathame janavātsalyaṃ dvitīye roganāśanam |
tṛtīyena kavitvaṃ ca dūrākarṣaṃ caturthake ||
pañcame vāci kāmitvaṃ ṣaṣṭhe bhūmiṃ parityajet |
saptame dūram ālokya cāṣṭame vajravad bhavet ||
navame sphurate kāyo daśame sāmarasyakam |
pṛthvīmadhye bhavet pṛthvī cāpām āpas tathaiva ca ||
tejomadhye bhavet tejo vāyur vāyau pralīyate |
ākāśo līyate sarvaḥ satattvaḥ piṇḍasaṃgrahaḥ ||
anāhato divārātrau dhvanate tu dhanaṃjayaḥ |
tatrārūḍho yadā yogī prāpnuyāt paramaṃ padam ||
